# `p287` item 1 ("read five national curriculum licences as PRIMARY SOURCES") was ranked
# first by p287 and p288 and NOT ADDRESSED by either.  p289 is the first pass to ATTEMPT it.
# It cannot be done from this environment, and that is a MEASUREMENT, not a deferral.
# Two independent channels, both recorded:
#   dns          — `getent hosts <host>` inside the sandbox
#   curl_connect — `curl -sI` through the agent proxy; 000 means the GATEWAY refused CONNECT
# 🔵 The channels AGREE, and the agreement is what makes the reading safe: allowlisted hosts
# resolve locally AND answer (raw.githubusercontent.com dns=RESOLVES https=301;
# github.com dns=RESOLVES https=400), so NXDOMAIN here is a gated resolver rather than a
# dead domain, and the gateway's own relay-failure ledger names each refusal:
#   "gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)"
# The ledger named 11 of the 12 rows below by host at the time it was read
# ($HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status, p798's ledger channel); basenacionalcomum.mec.gov.br
# was probed in the same batch and is carried on its curl verdict alone.
# 🔴 CONSEQUENCE FOR THE SHELVES: every curriculum-licence claim this base publishes is
# sourced from a DERIVATIVE PUBLISHER's restatement or from secondary press, never from the
# licensing authority's own text.  That is now a stated bound, not a silence.  The ONE
# exception this base has always claimed first-hand — ACARA (CC BY) — is on this table too,
# and it is POLICY-REFUSED like the rest.
